subject: Azure Marketplace tenant handover + sandbox validation plan
messages:
From: Azure Partner Onboarding <azurepartner@microsoft.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: contoso-marketplace@contoso.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Publisher tenant transfer & sandbox verification for Contoso offer

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. Contoso is asking to move their existing publisher listing into a new tenant that they control (legal entity restructure). Before the tenant handover we require a technical sandbox validation to ensure the offer deploys in the new tenant and that SaaS/CSP hookups continue to work (metering and co-sell telemetry).

High-level ask: can Redwood support a short sandbox run (3–5 business days) where Contoso provides a test subscription and we perform the publish/validation flow? We also need the following artifacts from Redwood/Contoso:
- MPN ID and proof of ownership
- Publisher contact that will administer the new tenant
- A minimal manifest and test script to validate API keys and telemetry

If you can share a proposed plan and timeline, we’ll schedule the validation window on our side and book an engineering review.

Thanks,

Angela Morris
Azure Partner Onboarding
Microsoft Corporation

[Attachment: partner-validation-guidelines-v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Azure Partner Onboarding <azurepartner@microsoft.com>, contoso-marketplace@contoso.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher tenant transfer & sandbox verification for Contoso offer

Hi Angela / Contoso team,

Appreciate the clear list. We can run the sandbox and coordinate the tenant handover. Proposed plan below (short timeline to minimize downtime):

1) Immediate items (today–48h):
   - Contoso to share MPN proof and designate publisher admin (Sally).
   - Contoso to provision a dedicated test subscription in the target tenant and invite redwood-engineering@redwood.com.

2) Sandbox validation (3 business days):
   - Day 1: Publish minimal offer manifest (staging) and verify deployment flow.
   - Day 2: Exercise SaaS metering endpoints, validate co-sell telemetry payloads, and run smoke tests.
   - Day 3: Run a rollback/fallback test and confirm telemetry in Partner Center.

3) Handover and cutover (weekend recommended):
   - Transfer listing ownership and update identity proofs.
   - Post-cutover monitoring for 48h.

Jonas will own the technical validation steps and Soojin will coordinate publisher ops and co-sell readiness.

Attachments I will share: a checklist and the minimal sandbox manifest (see attached). If this looks good, Sally can kick off the tenant invite and we’ll slot the validation window for next week.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: publisher-tenant-handover-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Azure Partner Onboarding <azurepartner@microsoft.com>, contoso-marketplace@contoso.com
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Publisher tenant transfer & sandbox validation for Contoso offer

Thanks Karthik — adding technical detail so Contoso/MS have the exact validation script.

Summary of tests (to be executed in the Contoso test subscription):
1) Offer manifest deploy (ARM + marketplace payload) using the staging publisher API keys. Verify: deployment succeeds, provisioning state = Succeeded.
2) Metering/call-home: push synthetic usage events to the usage endpoint and confirm Partner Center ingestion within 2 minutes.
3) Telemetry: ensure telemetry contains tenantId/publisherId mapping and co-sell flags.
4) Auth: validate OAuth client flow for the SaaS API (token issuance, scope mapping).
5) Fallback: simulate a duplicate publish from old tenant to ensure no duplicate GUID collisions.

I’ve attached a tiny manifest and a step-by-step script (sandbox-manifest-and-steps.txt). Note: we’ll need a test service principal from Contoso with Contributor + AppCatalog rights. If Contoso prefers, we can generate the SP and the team can consent during the sandbox window.

Jonas
Staff Engineer, Integrations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: sandbox-manifest-and-steps.txt (TXT)]

From: Sally Perez <sally.perez@contoso.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Azure Partner Onboarding <azurepartner@microsoft.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher tenant transfer & sandbox validation for Contoso offer

Hi all,

Thanks — this plan looks reasonable. Quick answers from our side:
- MPN ID and proof: attached (contoso-mpn-proof.jpg).
- Publisher admin: I will be the publisher admin for the new tenant (sally.perez@contoso.com).
- Test subscription: I’ll spin up a subscription in the new tenant and invite redwood-engineering@redwood.com by EOD tomorrow.

Questions:
1) For the SP permissions you requested, would it be safer for Contoso to create the SP and grant rights, or for Redwood to create and hand over? We prefer Contoso-owned credentials if possible.
2) Any specific rate limits or throttling we should expect during the metering test? We want to avoid tripping protection rules.

We’re aiming for the sandbox window starting Monday (Oct 19).

Thanks,
Sally Perez
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso Inc.

[Attachment: contoso-mpn-proof.jpg (JPG)]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, Sally Perez <sally.perez@contoso.com>
Cc: Azure Partner Onboarding <azurepartner@microsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Publisher tenant transfer & sandbox validation for Contoso offer

Sally — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers:
1) Contoso-owned SP is preferred. Please create the service principal and add the following roles: Contributor, AppCatalog Contributor, and a custom role that allows publishing access to the publisher resource. We’ll provide an exact role definition if needed.
2) Metering: keep synthetic usage under 500 events/min during Day 2 to avoid throttles. If you need higher volume we can request a temporary lift from the Partner Center team; give us the expected peak and we’ll coordinate.

Action items before Monday:
- Sally: create SP, invite redwood-engineering@redwood.com, and share subscription ID.
- Jonas: prepare smoke test script and monitoring dashboards.
- Karthik: confirm cutover weekend availability with Contoso execs.

I’ll prepare the co-sell readiness checklist and a short runbook for the validation window.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: runbook-co-sell-readiness.pdf (PDF)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sally Perez <sally.perez@contoso.com>, soojin_lee@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Azure Partner Onboarding <azurepartner@microsoft.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Publisher tenant transfer & sandbox validation for Contoso offer

Quick status update — kickoff happening today at 16:00 PT. Final housekeeping:
- Contoso to share test subscription ID and the SP client id in the kickoff channel.
- Jonas will run Day 1 manifest deploy and share logs to the Jira issue: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/MP-8421.
- Soojin will own the Partner Center verification and co-sell flags.

If anything blocks the deploy we’ll escalate to Azure Partner Onboarding immediately. Otherwise, target to finish sandbox on Wednesday (Oct 21) and schedule the cutover for the following weekend.

Appreciate everyone moving quickly on this.

—Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
